description: Rendering the inline adjust row alone against the real API, submitting a new quantity shows it in stock-cell-quantity before the response arrives with no reload
The inline adjust row, once the real API responds, shows the server-returned record.quantity in stock-cell-quantity
The inline adjust row given a below-zero quantity shows field-error-quantity naming quantity, reverts stock-cell-quantity to the stored Q
The inline adjust row submitted with a blank actor shows field-error-actor naming actor, with stock-cell-quantity unchanged

The adjustment-history panel for a record with seeded adjustments renders one history-entry-<n> per adjustment in time order, each with history-timestamp, history-actor, history-qty-before, history-qty-after
The adjustment-history panel for a record with no adjustments renders the history-empty empty-state instead of a blank table
The adjustment-history panel renders each history-entry-<n> read-only with no edit or delete control
